newsitem.title: USA: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke ends refuel outage.
newsitem.headline: HL&P 1,250 MW Texas nuke ends refuel outage.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's 1,250 megawatt (MW) South Texas nuclear power unit 2 was ending a refueling outage early Monday and preparing to resume electricity production, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, in Palacios, Texas, had moved into "hot standby" mode early Monday but had not yet begun to produce power, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
South Texas 2 was shut Feb 8 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The adjoining 1,250 MW South Texas nuclear power unit 1 was operating normally at 100 percent of output early Monday, the NRC said.
Houston Lighting & Power is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
